description: A three-dimensional cardboard box whose tape splits on click, its flaps fold open, and the order slip rises from inside and turns to face you.
interactionNotes: Clicking the box or the button beneath it opens or closes it; closing replays the opening film in reverse — a mid-way click only reverses direction and nothing jumps. Escape also closes it. The button under the box is always available to screen readers (with `hint={false}` it only becomes invisible) and receives `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`; the order slip stays `inert` until opened so focus cannot reach hidden content. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, the whole timeline reaches its destination in 10 milliseconds, so the state is correct but no motion plays.

props.open: Controlled open state; pass `onOpenChange` alongside it. Omit it to let the component manage itself.
props.defaultOpen: Start with the box open (uncontrolled mode).
props.onOpenChange: Called on every open/close; with `open` you can make it controlled.
props.slip: Content of the slip inside the box: title, subtitle, number, date, recipient, address, items and stamp. Any field you omit falls back to its Persian placeholder.
props.children: Replaces the default slip; renders in the 240×340 design space (takes precedence over `slip`).
props.colors: `{ box, tape, paper, ink, accent }`. Every face, shadow and cardboard texture derives from `box`; `accent` is the stamp color.
props.maxWidth: Maximum scene width, in pixels. The whole scene scales to fit its container (the minimum of the width ratio and `maxHeight`).
props.maxHeight: Maximum scene height, in pixels. Pass it for short frames so the open box does not overflow the frame; omit it so only width constrains the scene.
props.tape: The tape over the seam between the flaps; opening begins when it splits.
props.label: Label on the front face; `false` removes it.
props.symbols: Shipping symbols ("fragile" and "this side up") on the side face; `false` removes them.
props.hint: Label of the button under the box. With `false` the button remains for screen readers only (it is never removed).
props.openLabel: Button text in the closed state.
props.closeLabel: Button text in the open state.
props.reserveSpace: Reserve the open-state height up front so the page does not jump when the box opens — useful in long lists.
props.paperClassName: Extra class for the slip itself — for custom typography.

tips: This component is a physical object, not a layout: its rotation axes and face coordinates are not mirrored. The slip's text, however, is fully right-to-left and flips itself back with `text-start` and `justify-between`.

The scene height runs from 392px (closed) to 650px (open) in the design space. If you place it inside a short frame (card, panel), also pass `maxHeight` or the open box bursts out of the frame; `reserveSpace` also prevents the page from jumping.
For the slip text, write digits in Persian and make numeric columns `tabular-fa` so they do not jitter when values change. Isolate Latin codes (such as SKU) with `tabular-en`.

Do not make `box` too light or too dark: the shadow and lighting of each face derive from this color, and at both ends of the range the box looks flat. Earthy and brown cardboards give the best result.
On mobile, the box's hover float and `whileTap` both depend on `prefers-reduced-motion`; nothing needs to be switched off by hand.

The slip text sits inside `role="document"` with an `aria-label` and stays `inert` until opened; if you put interactive content inside the slip, remove the hint button with `hint={false}` so you do not have two controls for one job.
